topic: Basic Needs of Living Things and Environment
key_concepts: Living things grow, reproduce, move, breathe, and need food
Nonliving things do not need water, air, or food and cannot move or reproduce on their own
Humans and animals need oxygen to breathe
Water is essential for living things and quenches thirst and cleans the body
Food provides energy, nutrients, and immunity for humans and animals
Humans and animals need shelter for protection and safety
Plants need sunlight, water, and soil to grow
The sun provides energy that helps plants grow
Living things depend on the environment and on one another to meet their needs
